import subprocess, os, json
repo=r'C:\mcp-blender\vendor\projeto-salvador-elevador-lacerda'; tmp=r'C:\mcp-blender\.geo-work'; venv=r'C:\mcp-blender\.venv-geo\Scripts\python.exe'
